entries.title: III John 1:1
segments:
.
 

 
 Gaius. The same as Caius, a common Roman name.  It is not certain that the Caius here addressed was the same as the Gaius in

entries.title: III John 1:5
segments: Them that are brethren and strangers. Gaius is here praised for his helpfulness to Christians who were strangers, and who were comforted by his hospitality.

entries.title: III John 1:6
segments: On their journey.  The Christians aided were travelling preachers.

entries.title: III John 1:9
segments: Diotrephes. A Christian of some influence and authority in the church, but who opposed the apostle John.

entries.title: III John 1:12
segments: Demetrius. Not elsewhere mentioned.  He was not the Demetrius of

entries.title: III John 1:14
segments: Friends. The adherents of the apostle in his opposition to Diotrephes.
